issues.title: POST /api/v1/instances/:id/advance-timer does not exist
issues.description: swiftroute-shipment-ops-timeout-escalation.yaml step 2 requires a timer-advance endpoint that Letflow.Router does not expose. Confirmed by reading lib/letflow/router.ex and lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex: zero matches for 'advance-timer' or 'advance_timer' (machine-verified by req206_swiftroute_test.exs UNIMPLEMENTED findings test). The scenario's own note field anticipates this ('If not available, this scenario is marked SKIP with severity MINOR') — that exact disposition was applied. This finding requests the endpoint be built as new functionality in a future requirement, out of REQ-206's correctness-gate scope.

issues.title: No document/attachment API exists in Letflow or in R-Co's own src/
issues.description: swiftroute-shipment-attach-delivery-note.yaml (5 steps, all via: gui) has no possible real execution on either lane. Confirmed: (1) no attachment-related route in any lib/letflow/routers/*.ex (machine-verified by req206_swiftroute_test.exs UNIMPLEMENTED findings test — no 'attachment' or upload+shipment matches found); (2) R-Co's own src/ has no attachment/document-upload subsystem — the two src/ hits for 'attach'/'storage' are src/db/partition_attach.zig and src/design/iss501_storage_mode_routing.md, both unrelated to shipment document attachments (per REQ-206's own requirement text; R-Co src/ is unreachable from this session). This is a scenario describing a feature absent from both codebases, not a Letflow gap against an existing R-Co feature.

context.requirement_text: Second requirement of S7. Ports and runs, via REQ-205's harness, the four SwiftRoute scenario YAMLs confirmed present in R-Co at tests/simulation/scenarios/: swiftroute-tenant-onboarding-happy.yaml (5 steps, 4 via api / 1 via gui -- steps 1-3 use via: gui explicitly, step 4-5 also gui; GUI-first scenario per its own pipeline_test field pointing at web/tests/e2e/pipelines/onboarding-wizard.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts, which DOES exist in this repo's web/ -- record it per REQ-205's DEFERRED_TO_S8 rule because S8's integration work has not started; state the spec-exists-but-not-integrated distinction explicitly in the report), swiftroute-shipment-high-value-happy.yaml (3 steps, all via: api -- declared value EUR 750 exceeding the EUR 500 CEO co-sign threshold, exercises REQ-050's exclusive-gateway CEL/expr condition dispatch), swiftroute-shipment-ops-timeout-escalation.yaml (3 steps; step 2 requires POST /api/v1/instances/:id/advance-timer which does not exist; scenario's own note: 'If not available, this scenario is marked SKIP with severity MINOR.' Run steps 1 and 3 for real, mark step 2 SKIP/MINOR, report missing endpoint to ORCH as a finding, not built here), and swiftroute-shipment-attach-delivery-note.yaml (5 steps, all via: gui, no attachment/document-upload API in Letflow or R-Co; record as UNBUILT_FEATURE, zero steps executed, report finding to ORCH). For every scenario actually run, evaluate each expected_outcomes entry against real queried state and record PASS/FAIL with concrete evidence. NOT IN THIS REQUIREMENT: no advance-timer endpoint; no document-attachment subsystem; no web/ Playwright spec authoring; no Vortex or Meridian scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: swiftroute-tenant-onboarding-happy's api-equivalent provisioning (tenant + admin user + realm) is exercised through REQ-205's harness and its EO-001..EO-003-equivalent state (onboarding completed, slug/hostname registered, admin login-ready) is verified against real Letflow state; its gui steps are recorded DEFERRED_TO_S8 with the spec-exists-but-not-integrated distinction stated explicitly in the report

swiftroute-shipment-high-value-happy runs end to end (dispatcher submit -> ops approve -> CEO co-sign) against a real running instance and all 4 expected_outcomes are evaluated against real queried state (task assignment, instance status, completion timing), each recorded PASS or FAIL with the specific evidence

swiftroute-shipment-ops-timeout-escalation's step 1 and step 3 run for real; step 2 (timer advance) is recorded SKIP with severity MINOR exactly matching the scenario's own documented fallback; the missing POST /api/v1/instances/:id/advance-timer capability is reported to ORCH as a finding (not filed directly, per core-directives.md's No Issue Left Local-Only) with its file/line evidence (grep result showing zero matches)

swiftroute-shipment-attach-delivery-note is recorded UNBUILT_FEATURE with zero steps executed, and the finding (no document/attachment API exists in Letflow or in R-Co's own src/) is reported to ORCH with the specific R-Co paths checked and found not to contain the feature

the requirement's own report states, per scenario, a closed disposition set (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/DEFERRED_TO_S8/UNBUILT_FEATURE) for every one of the four scenarios' steps -- no step is left unaddressed or silently omitted

context.design_doc_summary: Design approved by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR recheck2 (commit 3360b30c). Key settled decisions: (1) Runner extension: add :skip via-type (with severity/note fields), UNBUILT_FEATURE disposition on RunReport, and scenario-level unbuilt_feature on Step; (2) Scenario YAML files authored synthetically in test/fixtures/simulation/scenarios/ mirroring R-Co's 4 swiftroute scenario YAMLs (real actor_ids from org_structure.yaml); (3) shipment-high-value-happy execution: alice is the dispatcher (POST /instances), GET /tasks?instance_id=<uuid>&status=PENDING to resolve ops/ceo task ids, POST /tasks/:id/complete with roles:[role-ops-manager]/[role-ceo] tokens; no claim-before-complete required (authorization.ex confirm); (4) advance-timer endpoint absent (grep-confirmed zero matches), report as finding in result.issues; (5) attachment scenario UNBUILT_FEATURE, zero steps, report finding in result.issues.
